And since AFAIK only one other source besides me is following the supply inflation rate (and IMO that other source is doing so wrongly by disregarding PoS issuance), that’s why I’m plotting my own charts using data from a trustworthy source: Etherscan. Thanks for your response, Micah.
The line of research that I’m actively pursuing is analyzing the effect that EIP-1559 has had on ETH supply. And since AFAIK only one other source besides me is following the supply inflation rate (and IMO that other source is doing so wrongly by disregarding PoS issuance), that’s why I’m plotting my own charts using data from a trustworthy source: Etherscan.
Although this Discord server is focused on development, I thought that maybe the developers who worked on EIP-1559 might be interested in seeing the tangible result of their work on ETH supply.
But if you still think that the charts that I shared are “random images”, I’ll be more than happy to delete that post and refrain from posting any more in the future.
Thanks again.
